community: Remote & backcountry, Fraser Valley Regional District

description.value: A free campsite within the high-elevation Coquihalla Summit Recreation Area, beside a 25-hectare lake offering rainbow trout fishing and granite peak scenery; no potable water is available and access is via a 1 km spur road west off Hwy 5.
